title: Crabbin' House South | KEY.co
description_expanded: Tucked away in the serene Lake District of WaterColor, this custom-built, designer-inspired vacation home is a haven of privacy and luxury, backing onto a lush wooded preserve. Ideal for families seeking both comfort and style, the residence boasts an open-concept living area furnished in coastal blues and vibrant greens, reflecting the tranquility of its surroundings. The heart of the home is a chef’s dream kitchen equipped with high-end Thermador appliances and an expansive farmhouse table for eight, perfect for gathering delicious meals. Further enhancing the ground floor is a screened porch, offering a secluded spot to enjoy morning coffee or unwind in the evening, alongside a cozy guest bedroom complete with a private bath. Upstairs, the personal retreats include a lavish master suite with a king-sized bed, an elegantly appointed bathroom featuring a soaking tub and custom-tiled shower, and a private screened balcony overlooking the woods. This floor also hosts two additional bedrooms, each with its own charm and ensuite facilities, one of which cleverly incorporates twin bunk beds, ideal for younger guests. The home’s luxury extends outdoors with an inviting wood-burning fireplace, a state-of-the-art gas grill station, and a refreshing outdoor shower, perfect for rinsing off after a day at the beach. Included amenities such as a 6-seat golf cart and beach cruiser bicycles invite exploration and adventure in this picturesque community.
